trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel-angle of approximately 50-60 degrees; depth is distinct and roughly 1/6th of total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the inner trailing edges; transitioning to macro-scale jagged protrusions with high-pixel amplitude at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve along the trailing edge, sweeping upward from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical parallel linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Textured calcified protrusions on the lateral tips; irregular jagged notch on the far-left trailing edge suggesting previous tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniform yellowish-tan chromatic overlay across the white pixel fields, likely indicating a surface biofilm or diatom colonization.
